muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīrī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿تر﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿ألم تر﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the place of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أصحاب الفيل﴾; or in the position of accusative standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the meaning being: "what manner of dealing did your Lord deal?" (أيّ فعل فعل ربك؟)
﴿فعل﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿ربك﴾: «رب» is fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and it is muḍāf, and the kāf is the pronoun of the addressee, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿بأصحاب﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «أصحاب» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, the sign of its genitive being the kasra, and it is muḍāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فعل﴾.
﴿الفيل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra; the clause ﴿كيف فعل ربك﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿ترَ﴾, because the seeing is of the heart (qalbiyya).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīrī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿يجعل﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring back to Allah the Exalted.
﴿كيدهم﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يجعل﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿في تضليل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of ﴿يجعل﴾; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وأرسل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أرسل» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو).
﴿عليهم﴾: «على» is a preposition, the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾.
﴿طيرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿أبابيل﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿طيرا﴾, accusative by the fatḥa; the clause ﴿أرسل...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ألم يجعل...﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ترميهم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "they" (هي), referring back to the birds, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بحجارة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترميهم﴾.
﴿من سجيل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «حجارة»; the clause ﴿ترميهم﴾ is in the position of accusative as a second naʿt of ﴿طيرا﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فجعلهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «جعلهم» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿كعصف﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿عصف﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿مأكول﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عصف﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the clause ﴿جعلهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أرسل﴾, with no grammatical position.
